name: Claire Merle
source:
"Together with us, let's do club activities, shall we?"

An exchange student from France and a third-year student in the Lady Training Department. She likes to take care of others and being close to everyone, often hugs them as a form of skinship. Giving off a relaxed vibe while being shrewd, she is a caring and kind older sister, but also relatively clumsy.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.ensemble-game.com/29.otohime/character_merle.html]official website[/url]]
